repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
    wait until((#Garden_Button).button_button != "pushed")
    fired = false
}
wait until((#Garden_Button).button_button == "pushed")
(#Garden_Valve).valve_open()
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a periodic `if` which only evaluates at the start of the 1000 ms cycle. The input evidence (F1) shows the button becomes 'pushed' at 100 ms, well before the next cycle start at 1000 ms. The IR requires a rising-edge wait to catch this change immediately. The fix replaces the periodic guard with a blocking wait that re-arms on the false state.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with the standard rising-edge state machine pattern using `wait until` and a persistent `fired` flag to ensure the action triggers exactly when the condition transitions from false to true, regardless of the wrapper period.
